title: I can add an account on Thunderbird, but how do I delete an account that I no longer use?

content: I have an email account on Thunderbird that I no longer use that I want to delete that account. I can very easily add an account to Thunderbird, but I can't seem to find any way to delete one. Is it even possible to delete an account?
